faqs.question: Can I switch plans anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately; downgrades apply at the next billing cycle.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes, all plans come with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards, ACH bank transfers, and wire transfers for Enterprise plans.

faqs.question: Do you offer discounts for non-profits or startups?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer 30% discounts for verified non-profits and early-stage startups (under $1M ARR). Contact sales@nexushq.com.

faqs.question: What does SSO include?
faqs.answer: SSO on Enterprise supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC. Compatible with Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and any SAML-compliant identity provider.

faqs.question: Where is data stored?
faqs.answer: By default, data is stored in the US. Enterprise customers can choose EU or APAC data residency at no extra cost.

faqs.question: What is the refund policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for Starter and Growth plans. Enterprise contracts are negotiated individually.
